label: Играть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for играть (to play).

missions.phrase: Я играю на гитаре каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Играть is imperfective with the regular stem игра-, giving the 1sg 'играю' with -ю. 'Играть на' plus the prepositional names the instrument played.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Играешь' shows the -ешь ending on игра-. 'Играть в' plus the accusative is the fixed pattern for playing a game.

missions.phrase: Брат играет во дворе с друзьями.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Играет' is the он-form ending in -ет. The imperfective describes an ongoing activity of playing outside with friends.

missions.phrase: Мы играем в футбол по выходным.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Играем' carries the -ем ending on игра-. 'По выходным' marks a recurring habit, which suits the imperfective aspect.
Strategic focus: Second-person plural or polite present. 'Играете' trains the respectful вы-form with the -ете ending. 'Играть на пианино' names the instrument in the prepositional.

missions.phrase: Дети играют в саду до вечера.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Играют' closes the present ladder with the -ют ending. The imperfective stresses the ongoing, continuing play of the children.

missions.phrase: Вчера он играл в карты допоздна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Играл' is the masculine singular past of imperfective играть with the -л suffix. The imperfective past stresses the ongoing process of playing.

missions.phrase: Она играла главную роль в спектакле.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Играла' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Играть роль' means to play a part, here describing an extended past performance.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Играли' is the plural past ending in -и, completing the past forms. 'Всю ночь' underlines the prolonged, continuous nature of the imperfective.
Strategic focus: Plural or polite imperative. 'Играйте' adds -те to the command stem for a group or respectful order. The imperfective imperative suits an ongoing activity carried on quietly.
